english.title: Drive / ride a motor vehicle on a footpath / causeway beside a road - outside Greater London
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) wilfully

(A)_[rode]_

a motor vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..) upon a footpath or causeway by the side of a road, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), made or set apart for the use or accommodation of foot passengers
english.legislation: Contrary to section 72 of the Highways Act 1835.

Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)

english.notes:
(i) See also offence wordings: H1013, H1014, H1015, H1090, H1091 and H4105.
(ii) See also offence wording: H363 - driving a motor vehicle on a footpath/bridle way being a road - under section 34 of the Road Traffic Act 1988.
(iii) Section 72 applies to the driving of 'a carriage of any description', which includes bicycles, tricycles , motor vehicles and trailers, as well as to certain animals.
(iv) Fixed penalty ticket scheme may be applied
